summary: Tested Saturn/PresetBridge JWT auth (register, login, me, logout, forgot/reset, brute-force lockout) and spot-checked existing core endpoints. Also E2E tested Login page, Register page, MarketingHeader + AppShell user state + logout via Playwright. 17/18 backend tests passed. 1 backend bug: POST /api/auth/reset-password returns 500 due to naive/aware datetime comparison. All frontend flows work as expected.

critical.issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at auth.py:230. Reset token roundtrips through Mongo as naive datetime, then compared against datetime.now(timezone.utc). Returns 500 to client. Blocks entire password-reset flow.

issues: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login/Register)'. Likely a navigate() call happening during render instead of inside useEffect. Non-fatal but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Fix reset_password datetime comparison in /app/backend/auth.py line ~230. Either always store expires_at as ISO string and parse to tz-aware, or normalize `exp = exp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if exp.tzinfo is None else exp` before comparison.
Fix setState-during-render warning on Login and Register pages (wrap navigate() in useEffect that watches auth state).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py reset_password: naive datetime from Mongo vs tz-aware now — 500 error. Bug.
auth.py forgot_password / reset_password use `body: dict` instead of a Pydantic model — no validation; email/password not typed. Minor code quality.
auth.py get_current_user reads token from Authorization header OR access_token cookie, but frontend uses only localStorage bearer; cookie path is untested and not documented.
seed_admin() correctly re-hashes when .env password changes (verified by successful admin login).
Brute-force lockout uses ip+email identifier; behind a reverse proxy request.client.host may always be the proxy IP — acceptable but note it locks all users sharing that IP for the same email.
test_credentials: admin@saturn.dev / Saturn2026! (seeded, verified). Registered several throwaway users e2e-*@studio.com during testing.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; ephemeral test users only. Login-attempts records for lock-*@studio.com left in DB (expire naturally in 15 min).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin seed and JWT flow all working. Only remaining backend bug is the reset-password 500. After the fix, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_core.py — the test parses the reset link from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log automatically. Frontend Login/Register/nav/appshell auth UI all confirmed with data-testids.
rca of the issue: reset_password: `expires_at` was stored as a Python datetime (tz-aware) via insert_one; Motor/pymongo drops tzinfo on BSON encode -> retrieved as naive datetime. Line 224-230 only converts string values via fromisoformat; datetime values pass through as naive and then `exp < datetime.now(timezone.utc)` raises TypeError. Fix: normalize `if isinstance(exp, datetime) and exp.tzinfo is None: exp = exp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` after the isoformat branch, or store expires_at as ISO string on insert.
